answer: Proof of Stake secures an AI economy by tethering identity to capital, functioning like an ember that ignites consensus while preventing a downward spiral of malicious nodes. By staking tokens, agents map their reputation across a digital atlas where validation power scales with assets. This forces attackers to acquire prohibitively expensive collateral, rendering the cost of deploying millions of fake identities economically irrational compared to the diminishing returns of a compromised network.
